items.title: Indian Bank Warns Users of Fake LPG Payment and KYC Update Scams to Steal Banking Info
items.description: Indian Bank has issued an urgent cybersecurity advisory warning its customers about a rapidly spreading wave of fraudulent LPG payment and KYC update messages that are being used to steal banking credentials and drain accounts. items.title: Multiple OpenSSL Vulnerabilities Exposes Sensitive Data in RSA KEM Handling
items.description: OpenSSL has released a broad April 2026 security update that fixes seven vulnerabilities across supported branches, led by CVE-2026-31790, a moderate-severity flaw in RSA KEM RSASVE encapsulation that can expose uninitialized memory to a malicious peer. items.description: A critical vulnerability chain in the Common Unix Printing System (CUPS) that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary malicious code with root system privileges.
